attribute.zhushenspace.strength.desc: Raw physical power. Each point raises attack damage and attack speed, and slightly improves movement speed and knockback resistance. A key resistance attribute against Freeze.
attribute.zhushenspace.strength.legend: ★ Legendary (active once Strength is maxed): further increases attack damage, scaling with your legendary points.
attribute.zhushenspace.agility.desc: Footwork and reflexes. Base defense uses the higher of Agility and Perception; reflex save = Agility + Athletics + legendary Agility. Each point also raises jump height and safe fall distance, and improves movement efficiency on slowing ground such as soul sand and in water. A key resistance attribute against Freeze and Burn; also used to put out flames on yourself.
attribute.zhushenspace.agility.legend: ★ Legendary (active once Agility is maxed): legendary Agility adds to reflex saves, and to base defense while Agility is not lower than Perception.
attribute.zhushenspace.endurance.desc: Constitution and resilience. Each point raises max health and extends underwater breathing; at max Endurance, harmful effects you receive last shorter. Fortitude save = Endurance + Survival + legendary Endurance. Also raises max stamina; a key resistance attribute against Burn, Tinnitus and Dazzle.
attribute.zhushenspace.endurance.legend: ★ Legendary (active once Endurance is maxed): additional max health and reduced food exhaustion — the more legendary points, the less you tire; legendary Endurance adds to fortitude saves.
attribute.zhushenspace.intelligence.desc: Learning and insight. Key attribute for magic (innate magic uses Charm). Magic pool = INT + PER. Occultism and Science also raise it.
attribute.zhushenspace.intelligence.lege: ★ Legendary (active once Intelligence is maxed): grants an experience dividend scaling with your legendary points (coming soon).
attribute.zhushenspace.perception.desc: Awareness and intuition. Base defense uses the higher of Agility and Perception. Attacks may reveal a yellow weak-point marker on the target, more often with higher Perception; only hitting the marker deals extra weak-point damage, with a crisp sound and particles. Gun hits on weak points deal less extra damage, and a weak point broken by gunfire takes a moment to reappear. Perceives what others cannot (coming soon). A key resistance attribute against Tinnitus and Dazzle.
attribute.zhushenspace.perception.legend: ★ Legendary (active once Perception is maxed): legendary Perception adds to base defense while Perception is higher than Agility; extended perception range (coming soon).
attribute.zhushenspace.resolve.desc: Will and conviction. Willpower pool = RES + COM, fully restored by a long rest; Willpower, Will Guard and holding on while unconscious are used from the Action Wheel (Z). Mind checks = RES + COM; will saves = Resolve + Feeling + legendary Resolve.
attribute.zhushenspace.resolve.legend: ★ Legendary (active once Resolve is maxed): Willpower capacity grows with legendary points (no longer enlarges energy pools); legendary Resolve adds to will saves.
attribute.zhushenspace.charm.desc: Presence and charm. Key attribute for echo checks, Taoism and Yokai arts; part of the Dao, Buddha and Yokai pools.
attribute.zhushenspace.charm.legend: ★ Legendary (active once Charisma is maxed): higher Gene Lock unlock chance, scaling with your legendary points (coming soon).
attribute.zhushenspace.operation.desc: Control and coordination; affects skill acquisition and summoning/commanding abilities (coming soon).
attribute.zhushenspace.operation.legend: ★ Legendary (active once Operation is maxed): attacks may critically strike for higher damage; crit chance scales with your legendary points; gun crits deal a smaller bonus.
attribute.zhushenspace.composure.desc: Calm and poise. Willpower pool = RES + COM; mind checks = RES + COM; part of the Spirit, Mind and Psionic pools.
attribute.zhushenspace.composure.legend: ★ Legendary (active once Composure is maxed): enlarges your main energy pool (stacks with Resolve) and increases movement speed, scaling with your legendary points.

skill.zhushenspace.athletics.desc: Overall conditioning. Reflex save = Agility + Athletics + legendary Agility; area saves build on the reflex save. Used for thrown and bow attacks: Agility + Athletics + weapon damage − target defense − range penalty ± modifiers (the farther beyond the range unit, the larger the penalty). Unlocks Self-Protection, Leap and Climb.
skill.zhushenspace.brawl.desc: Unarmed fighting. Brawl attack: Strength + Brawl + natural weapon damage − target defense ± modifiers. Unlocks Brawl Block, Trip and Charge Attack.
skill.zhushenspace.blade.desc: Melee with artificial weapons. Blade attack: Strength + Blade + weapon damage − target defense ± modifiers. Categories: Longsword (vanilla swords), Greatsword, Rapier, Fan; gain free professions as the skill rises (professions from points are capped), other categories take an equipment penalty (uncategorized items need none). Unlocks Blade Block (brief parry defense).
skill.zhushenspace.occultism.desc: Arcane lore; each level raises INT. Casting check = key attribute + Occultism, also added to spell damage caps.
skill.zhushenspace.science.desc: Pursuit of scientific truth; each point raises Intelligence.
skill.zhushenspace.expression.desc: Self-expression. Echo check = CHA + an expression sub-skill (sing / music / dance / acting / speech).
skill.zhushenspace.firearms.desc: Marksmanship. Gun attack: Agility (Intelligence for cannons) + Firearms + weapon damage − target defense ± modifiers; multi-pellet guns split the bonus across pellets. Categories: Pistol, SMG, Shotgun, Machine Gun, Rifle (incl. sniper), Cannon; gain free professions as the skill rises (professions from points are capped), others take an equipment penalty. Requires TACZ.
skill.zhushenspace.feeling.desc: Sensitivity to yourself and the world around you. Will save = Resolve + Feeling + legendary Resolve + other bonuses, used against mind effects and conditions such as Bind, Charm and Fear.
skill.zhushenspace.survival.desc: The knack of enduring harsh conditions. Fortitude save = Endurance + Survival + legendary Endurance + other bonuses, used against Freeze, Nausea, Bleeding and other fortitude effects. Unlocks Self-Protection (either this or Athletics).
ability.zhushenspace.self_protection.des: Briefly gain extra defense; the amount depends on your Agility and Athletics. Unlocked by either Athletics or Survival.
ability.zhushenspace.leap.desc: Empowers your next jump; the boost depends on your Strength and Athletics and ends once you jump.
ability.zhushenspace.climb.desc: For a short while you can climb up walls; the total height depends on your Strength and Athletics.
ability.zhushenspace.brawl_block.desc: Briefly gain parry defense; the amount depends on your Brawl level. No effect while flat-footed or unable to block.
ability.zhushenspace.trip.desc: Your next hit within a short window knocks the target down (heavy slowness and weakness); flying targets drop instantly.
ability.zhushenspace.charge_attack.desc: For a short while, the farther you charge, the more damage your next hit deals (capped); on hit the bonus is consumed and you briefly lose an equal amount of base defense.
ability.zhushenspace.blade_block.desc: Briefly gain parry defense; the amount depends on your Blade level. No effect while flat-footed or unable to block.

msg.zhushenspace.breath.on: Neili Breath: ON - melee attacks consume 1 Neili for +6 damage
ability.zhushenspace.neili_breath.desc: Toggle: while on, each direct melee hit (including basic attacks) spends a little Neili for a large damage boost. Use again to turn off.
ability.zhushenspace.neili_meditate.desc: Sit and meditate for a moment (unable to move) to fully restore Neili; Neili capacity depends on Endurance and Perception. Long cooldown.
ability.zhushenspace.tc_ward_off.desc: Costs Neili: a brawl attack carrying heavy move damage.
ability.zhushenspace.tc_roll_back.desc: Costs Neili: a brawl attack that follows up with a heavy extra hit.
ability.zhushenspace.tc_press.desc: Costs Neili: a brawl attack with extra damage; if the target has absorption, adds more damage to shatter it (Spell Pierce, capped).
ability.zhushenspace.tc_push.desc: Costs Neili: a brawl attack with extra damage.
ability.zhushenspace.tc_pull.desc: Costs Neili: a brawl attack that deals severe damage on hit, reducing the target's max health (players suffer severe wounds instead).
ability.zhushenspace.tc_split.desc: Costs Neili: a brawl attack that suppresses the target on hit, weakening and slowing it for a while.
ability.zhushenspace.tc_elbow.desc: Costs Neili: a brawl attack that converts part of the target's defense into extra damage (Armor Break).
ability.zhushenspace.tc_shoulder.desc: Costs Neili: a brawl attack that knocks the target back based on damage dealt; slamming into a wall inflicts extra blunt severe damage.
ability.zhushenspace.tc_tingjin.desc: Costs Neili: for a while your attack power drops, and the damage you take drops as well (yield to overcome).
ability.zhushenspace.tc_eight_powers.des: [Passive] All eight jin fused into one. When an unarmed normal attack hits hard enough, it carries one jin, cycling Ward-off → Roll-back → Press → Push → Pull → Split → Elbow → Shoulder: Ward-off, Roll-back and Push add damage; Press pierces absorption; Pull saps vitality; Split suppresses (weakness and slowness); Elbow breaks armor; Shoulder knocks back into walls (wall hits sap vitality). Also lowers the Neili cost of the eight Tai Chi moves.
ability.zhushenspace.tc_yinshou.desc: Costs Neili: enter the luring-hand stance for a while. Each attack you take (if the attacker can be located) stacks a debuff on them (lower attack, contests and defense); max stacks depend on your Brawl level. The debuff lasts a while and refreshes when stacked.
ability.zhushenspace.tc_lanquewei.desc: Ready stance: on the first melee attack you receive, skip the to-hit and contest attack power directly (yours includes Brawl and the Tai Chi unarmed bonus). Win to disarm their main-hand weapon (dropped) and make the attack miss; Neili is spent and the cooldown starts on resolution.
ability.zhushenspace.tc_cloudhands.desc: Ready stance: on the first melee attack you receive, contest attack power (grapple). Win to reduce that attack's damage by the margin and grapple the attacker, heavily slowing it; Neili is spent and the cooldown starts on resolution.
ability.zhushenspace.tc_seabottom.desc: Ready stance: when hit in melee or when a nearby target moves, contest attack power (trip). An attack-triggered win reduces the damage based on the margin; a movement-triggered win immobilizes the target (heavy slowness and weakness); Neili is spent and the cooldown starts on resolution.
ability.zhushenspace.tc_coilingsilk.desc: [Passive] Your inner force flows endlessly, fine and resilient as silk. While your Neili pool is not empty, you gain a bonus to disarm, grapple and trip contests.
ability.zhushenspace.tc_dissolve.desc: Ready stance: when hit in melee by a target using an energy pool, counter with a brawl attack, then may chain one learned Grasp the Bird's Tail / Cloud Hands / Needle at Sea Bottom. If the counter deals damage or the chain succeeds, their energy pool is sealed for a while (no spending or breath); Neili is spent and the cooldown starts on resolution.

feat.zhushenspace.born_femboy.level0:
You were born as cute or charming as a girl, even though you are male.
Effect: slender and petite, with a girlish face. For prerequisites and effects of resource exchanges other than feats, talents, flaws and quirks you count as female rather than male. Against gender-targeted negative effects you also count as male; against gender-targeted attacks and organ-targeted effects you still count as male.
feat.zhushenspace.wastelander.level3:
You survived a post-apocalyptic wasteland.
Effect: immune to natural poisons and diseases (poison, hunger, nausea); max HP +2.
feat.zhushenspace.monstrous_strength.lev:
You were born with monstrous strength.
For grapple, bull rush, trip and size-based prerequisites your size counts as one step larger (stacks with Strong Back).
feat.zhushenspace.barbarian.prereq: A physical attribute (STR / AGI / END) at 3
feat.zhushenspace.barbarian.level3:
You come from an ancient "uncivilised" tribe.
Immune to natural difficult terrain (water, cobweb, soul sand). +1 to STR, AGI or END (does not change caps). Without heavy armor (iron / diamond / netherite) base speed +4 m (1 m = 10% base speed).
feat.zhushenspace.future_human.level3:
Born in a sci-fi future with evolved genes.
INT-related checks gain 1 bonus success; you gain all Science specialisations (incl. Blueprint Reading) with a +2 specialisation bonus.
feat.zhushenspace.giant_body.prereq: Cannot be taken with Dwarf Body
feat.zhushenspace.giant_body.level4:
You are nearly 3 m tall.
Volume becomes 7 (humans are 4-5). Every 2 volume above 5: +1 STR, -1 AGI, +1 natural defense, -1 dodge. You count as a Large creature.
feat.zhushenspace.sixth_sense.level3:
You sense the supernatural.
You gain the Spirit pool and may learn general Spirit arts (D: RES or COM 6, C: 11, B: 16, A: 21, S: 31).
feat.zhushenspace.psionic_talent.level3:
Your mind is exceptionally strong.
You gain the Mind pool and may learn general Mind arts (D: RES or COM 6, C: 11, B: 16, A: 21, S: 31).
feat.zhushenspace.yokai_blood.level3:
Yokai blood runs in your veins.
You gain the Yokai pool and may learn Yokai arts (D: CHA or END 6, C: 11, B: 16, A: 21, S: 31). You count as non-human.
feat.zhushenspace.reincarnated_buddha.pr: Requires RES 3, CHA 3, no mental flaws
feat.zhushenspace.reincarnated_buddha.le:
You are an unawakened living Buddha.
You gain the Buddha pool and may learn general Buddhist spells (D: Occult 4 + RES 6 ... S: Occult 14 + RES 31). Caster level stays D.
feat.zhushenspace.magic_constitution.lev:
Magic flows from within you.
You gain the Magic pool and may learn general magic (D: Occult 4 + INT 6 ... S: Occult 14 + INT 31). Caster level stays D.
feat.zhushenspace.innate_dao_body.level3:
You were born close to the Dao.
You gain the Dao pool and may learn general Taoist spells (D: Occult 4 + CHA 6 ... S: Occult 14 + CHA 31). Caster level stays D.
feat.zhushenspace.psychic_constitution.l:
Psionic power flows in your blood.
You gain the Psionic pool and may learn general psionics (D: RES or COM 6, C: 11, B: 16, A: 21, S: 31).
feat.zhushenspace.martial_prodigy.level3:
A once-in-a-generation martial talent.
You gain the Neili pool and may learn general martial arts (D: Brawl/Blade 4 + END 6 ... S: 14 + END 31).
feat.zhushenspace.chakra_constitution.le:
Chakra of the Otsutsuki flows in you.
You gain the Chakra pool and may learn general ninjutsu (D: Occult 4 + PER 6 ... S: Occult 14 + PER 31). Caster level stays D.
ability.zhushenspace.grapple.desc: Grab a target in reach: STR+Brawl (+natural weapon) vs their grapple or escape; the winner deals the margin as grapple points. While grappling: use again to take movement control (once per 3s round), sneak-use to break free.

ability.zhushenspace.art_spirit_slash.de: Launch a pale spirit blade. Range equals Resolve (minimum 2); damage on collision. Check/cap: Resolve + Composure + held weapon; pure energy.
ability.zhushenspace.art_spirit_heal.des: Heal 6 on a target within RES m (sneak = self), serious wounds first.
ability.zhushenspace.art_hadoken.desc: Hold to charge, release a physical wave projectile (range 50, speed-8 defense modifier). Full charge at 2s, up to 2x power. Damage on collision. Costs 1 inner energy. Original prerequisites apply; research variants remain reserved.
ability.zhushenspace.art_eight_formation: Hold to raise palms and form a forward Bagua seal; release three matching laser pulses, range 20. One damage resolution per target per cast. Full charge at 2s, up to 2x power. Select element in wheel; no energy cost.
ability.zhushenspace.art_wind_slash.desc: Swing a pale mint-green blade projectile, range 16. Blade attack on collision; ignores natural defense, adds legendary agility x3, knocks up. Costs 1 yokai energy.
ability.zhushenspace.art_basic_palm.desc: Self, 1 min: dodge defense +6 (lost while flat-footed), unarmed brawl +3DP (+9). Cost 1 Neili.
Hold for hand seals (minimum 0.6s), release a large fireball. Range 40; impact blast radius 10 (diameter 20), blocked by walls, no terrain damage. Full charge at 2s, up to 2x power; reflex save applies. Costs 3 chakra.

status.zhushenspace.drowsy.desc: Attacks, casting, psychic checks and initiative are penalized.

condition.zhushenspace.manic.desc: Cannot stay still, use willpower or rest.
condition.zhushenspace.hysteria.desc: Mental disorder: cannot calm down, use willpower or rest.
condition.zhushenspace.panic.desc: Flees the feared target in panic.
condition.zhushenspace.asleep.desc: Cannot act; wakes on damage or when roused by another's standard action.
condition.zhushenspace.eternal_sleep.des: Falls into a sleep that never ends.
condition.zhushenspace.blood_loss.desc: Bashing and lethal damage heal as slowly as aggravated damage, which cannot be healed.
condition.zhushenspace.open_wound.desc: A wound left by a lost limb deals damage every round until the limb is restored or the wound is dressed; stacks.
condition.zhushenspace.limb_disabled.des: A limb is temporarily unusable: one arm means one-handed, both arms means nothing can be held and gestures fail; one leg makes moving harder, both legs remove land speed.
condition.zhushenspace.silenced.desc: Cannot speak or cast spells that need words.
condition.zhushenspace.banished.desc: Banished from this world: cannot act and is unaffected by any ability.

condition.zhushenspace.asphyxia.desc: Cannot breathe and can hold out only briefly.

condition.zhushenspace.weary.desc: Long without enough sleep: periodic Endurance checks add Fatigue and drain Composure on failure; ends after a full sleep.

ability.zhushenspace.art_thunder_sword.d: [Light] Evocation | 1 mana | Verbal | Touch | One target | 1 round (3s). Melee spell attack (spell check); your held blade's weapon damage replaces power and all weapon effects apply. On a hit, damage is calculated but not dealt: the target is marked with that amount. If it moves of its own accord (including teleporting) during its next round, it immediately takes that much serious lightning damage and the effect ends; otherwise the mark lasts until the end of that round.
ability.zhushenspace.art_light.desc: [Light] Conjuration | 0 mana | Verbal | Touch | Target: one item (a holder must be willing) | 10 minutes. The item lights a 20 m radius, making it a bright environment. Uses your main/off hand item first; with empty hands, the dropped item you look at, or the held item of a sneaking (willing) player.
ability.zhushenspace.art_illumination.de: [Light] Conjuration | 1 mana | Verbal, Somatic | Touch | No target | Area: 10 m radius sphere | 10 minutes. Four floating light orbs appear in front of you: no collision, cannot be attacked, harmless to touch, but affected by dispel effects. Dark or dim surroundings within their radius become bright; spirit creatures in range lose the invisibility granted by their spirit nature (revealed and glowing).
ability.zhushenspace.art_frost_claw.desc: [Dark][Water] Necromancy | 0 mana | Verbal, Somatic | Range = INT m | One target | Instant. Ranged spell attack dealing serious cold damage. Research Undead Bane (6XP): an undead target takes a -6 profane penalty on attack checks until the start of your next turn. Research Blight (12XP): damage becomes mixed cold and unholy serious damage.

feat.zhushenspace.unkillable_roach.level:
You are a thick-skinned, hard-to-kill roach, just like the Bronze Saints.
Max HP +2.
feat.zhushenspace.wolf_child.level3:
You were raised by beasts in the wild.
· Immune to natural difficult terrain (water, cobwebs, soul sand).
· Your natural weapons (unarmed) deal serious damage.
· Illiterate: you cannot read written books or book and quill, cannot use lecterns, and sign text looks like gibberish (the mod's guide book is unaffected). Can be bought off for 3 XP.
· Fear of fire: on seeing fire you unavoidably gain 3 Fear. Can be bought off for 3 XP.
· On taking this feat your Intelligence becomes 1 and you choose Strength, Agility or Endurance +1 (does not change attribute caps); Intelligence can no longer be raised.
Choose one:
[Tarzan] Climb without checks at half base speed; standing or walking jumps get the sprint-jump boost.
[Wolf Child] Base speed +5 m; +3DP on trip checks and against trips.
feat.zhushenspace.telekinesis_talent.lev:
Sometimes you bend spoons without meaning to.
You gain the Telekinesis pool (special essence) and innately know Telekinetic Strike and Telekinetic Control; Telekinetic Strike can deal serious damage.
· Pool = Resolve + Composure; recovers 3x its total per day, spread hourly (per 10 minutes if over 6 per hour).
· Effective Strength = legendary Resolve x2, effective Agility = legendary Composure x2 (they can gain legendary values themselves); range = (legendary Resolve + legendary Composure, min 1) x5 m.
· Spend 1 on Athletics / Brawl / Blade checks for an energy bonus equal to effective Strength.
· With the force field on, spend 1 when attacked for defense + effective Agility (reduced by spellbreak).
· Telekinesis bonuses count only once.

ability.zhushenspace.art_tk_attack.desc: [Special] Telekinesis | 1 telekinesis | range = effective range | one target | instant, no gesture. Crush the target with an invisible grip: a ranged mind attack (mind check, cap + effective Strength) dealing physical blunt damage; serious with Telekinesis Talent.
ability.zhushenspace.art_tk_manip.desc: [Special] Telekinesis | 1 telekinesis | lasts Resolve rounds (1 round = 3 s). Use doors, levers, buttons and containers within effective range; empty-hand use grabs dropped items; empty-hand use on a creature pushes it (effective Strength contest), sneak-use lifts it instead. Held items and creatures float along your crosshair (moving them slows you; they drop out of range or sight): scroll to push / pull (sneak also pulls), use to drop, attack to throw toward the crosshair - thrown items make a throwing attack on creatures they hit, thrown creatures take impact damage (as does whatever they slam into) on hitting walls or creatures, and fall damage applies on landing. Hotbar weapons (up to effective Agility) float behind you and strike your crosshair target on attack, using effective Strength and weapon skill.

trial.zhushenspace.hint.0: Press %1$s to open your inventory, then click the "Main God Panel" tab above it. Attributes, skills, feats and arts all live here.
trial.zhushenspace.hint.1: Closed the picker? Step onto the glowing pad in the middle of the room to reopen it. Each card comes with an energy pool and matching arts, and everything is reverted when you leave.
trial.zhushenspace.hint.2: Cobwebs and soul sand are difficult terrain and slow you down. The vines on the wall can be climbed; press %4$s to jump the gap, and if you fall, climb back out on the ladder. With enough Athletics, the Leap and Climb skills on your bar make this easier.
trial.zhushenspace.hint.3: Press %2$s to toggle combat mode: the hotbar becomes your skill bar. Aim at the dummy and press %5$s to attack. In combat mode, number keys use the skill in that slot.
trial.zhushenspace.hint.4: Hold %3$s to open the action wheel, choose "Full Defense", then step up to the puppet. Full Defense greatly raises your defense but ends as soon as you attack. If you have willpower, press %6$s to ready Will Guard for extra defense against the next hit. Open your inventory and hover the defense panel to read the damage-reduction keywords.
trial.zhushenspace.hint.5: Press %4$s to get up (it takes a moment). Hold %3$s to open the action wheel and choose "Put Out Fire" and "First Aid". The wound panel shows the damage you have taken.

trial.zhushenspace.prompt.title: Tutorial Trial
trial.zhushenspace.prompt.text:
New reincarnator detected.
Enter the tutorial trial first?

The trial uses a trial character: it costs no XP and does not touch your inventory or save, and falling there costs nothing. You can enter again any time with /zs tutorial start.
trial.zhushenspace.room.6.sub: Spend energy to cast an art
trial.zhushenspace.room.7.sub: Put everything you learned to use
trial.zhushenspace.room.8.sub: Have a drink and catch your breath
trial.zhushenspace.room.9.sub: Step onto the pad to return to the Main God Space
trial.zhushenspace.goal.6.1: Hit the dummy with an art
trial.zhushenspace.hint.6: Arts sit on your skill bar: press the number key to cast them, which spends the matching energy pool shown on the left. Hit the dummy soon after casting. Hold %3$s for the pool's other uses.
trial.zhushenspace.hint.7: Clear the three regular enemies first; the mini-boss comes next. Use the pillars to keep your distance. Skills and arts are all fair game, and your pools have been refilled. If you fall, you restart the fight from the room entrance.
trial.zhushenspace.hint.8: Hold %7$s and press %8$s on water with an empty hand to drink. Hold %3$s and choose "Short Rest" on the action wheel: stand still, and when it ends it heals light wounds and restores stamina and some energy. A long rest takes a real 8 hours, so the trial only shows the short rest; meditation restores energy pools.
trial.zhushenspace.hint.9: Step onto the glowing pad at the end of the room to finish the trial and see your results.
trial.zhushenspace.narr.speaker: MAIN GOD
trial.zhushenspace.narr.0:
Welcome to the Main God Space, reincarnator.
Here, every move you make is checked and recorded.
Open the Main God Panel and take a look at yourself.
trial.zhushenspace.narr.1:
A blank character can do nothing.
Pick a trial card. It costs no XP; it is only on loan.
trial.zhushenspace.narr.2:
The road in a dungeon is never smooth.
Webs and sand will slow you, walls and pits will stop you.
Learn to climb and jump, then make it across.
trial.zhushenspace.narr.3:
Combat mode turns your hotbar into a skill bar.
Whether you hit depends on your check minus their defense. Numbers do not lie.
Go on, hit the dummy. It will not hit back.
trial.zhushenspace.narr.4:
Knowing how to hit is half of it. Knowing how to take a hit is the other half.
This puppet will keep swinging, but it cannot kill you.
Raise Full Defense and see how much less it hurts.
trial.zhushenspace.narr.5:
Wounds do not go away on their own.
If you are down, get up. If you burn, put it out. If you bleed, stop it.
In a real dungeon, no one will do it for you.
trial.zhushenspace.narr.6:
Your energy pools are the source of your power, and its limit.
Every art has a price.
Land one on the dummy.
trial.zhushenspace.narr.7:
Now put everything you have learned to use.
Clear out the small fry first. The real opponent comes after.
Falling is fine. This is still a trial.
trial.zhushenspace.narr.8:
Only those who survive get to rest.
Have a drink and sit down for a moment.
A short rest heals light wounds, a long rest takes the whole night, and meditation brings back energy.
trial.zhushenspace.narr.9:
The trial ends here.
Next, spend your XP and create your true self.
The Main God Space looks forward to your performance.
